headline: Airtel Africa Commences New Share Buyback Tranche for 12 Million Shares
summary: Airtel Africa Plc initiated a new tranche of its share buyback program targeting up to 12.03 million ordinary shares, representing 0.33% of its issued share capital.
why: Share buybacks reduce total shares outstanding, which can provide price support and signal management confidence in the company's valuation.

impacts.name: Airtel Africa PLC
impacts.why: Repurchasing shares reduces float and can support equity prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
